title: "Library - Equipment"
format: html

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| include: false

library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(dplyr)
library(jsonlite)

# Connect to database
con <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../../asset/demonax-test.sqlite")

items <- dbReadTable(con, "items")
item_loot_sources <- dbReadTable(con, "item_loot_sources")
item_prices <- dbReadTable(con, "item_prices")
creatures <- dbReadTable(con, "creatures")
npc_locations <- dbReadTable(con, "npc_locations")

DBI::dbDisconnect(con)

# Helper function to generate NPC map links (vectorized)
generate_npc_map_link <- function(npc_name, x, y, z) {
  mapply(function(name, x_coord, y_coord, z_coord) {
    if (is.na(name) || is.na(x_coord) || is.na(y_coord) || is.na(z_coord)) {
      return(name)
    }
    zoom <- 5
    hash <- sprintf("#%d,%d,%d,%d?crosshair=1&npcs=1", x_coord, y_coord, z_coord, zoom)
    url <- sprintf("/map/index.html%s", hash)
    return(sprintf('<a href="%s" style="color: #004294; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500;">%s</a>',
                   url, name))
  }, npc_name, x, y, z, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

# Parse JSON attributes for all items
parse_attrs <- function(attr_json) {
  tryCatch({
    if(is.na(attr_json) || attr_json == "") return(list())
    fromJSON(attr_json)
  }, error = function(e) list())
}

items$parsed_attrs <- lapply(items$attributes, parse_attrs)

# Get available item images to avoid 404s
item_files <- list.files("../../asset/img/item", pattern = "^[0-9]+\\.png$")
available_items <- as.integer(gsub("\\.png$", "", item_files))

# Create extraction function
extract_attributes <- function(parsed_attrs_list, attr_config) {
  result <- list()

  for(attr_name in names(attr_config)) {
    config <- attr_config[[attr_name]]

    result[[config$output_name]] <- sapply(parsed_attrs_list, function(x) {
      # Check both exact match and case-insensitive match
      value <- NULL
      if(attr_name %in% names(x)) {
        value <- x[[attr_name]]
      } else {
        matching_names <- names(x)[tolower(names(x)) == tolower(attr_name)]
        if(length(matching_names) > 0) {
          value <- x[[matching_names[1]]]
        }
      }

      if(is.null(value)) return(config$default)

      switch(config$type,
        "integer" = as.integer(value),
        "numeric" = as.numeric(value),
        "character" = as.character(value),
        value
      )
    })
  }

  return(result)
}

# Create damage type decoder (vectorized)
decode_damage_types <- function(bitfield) {
  sapply(bitfield, function(bf) {
    if(is.na(bf) || bf == 0) return("")

    damage_types <- c(
      "Physical" = 1,
      "Poison" = 2,
      "Fire" = 4,
      "Energy" = 8,
      "Poison (periodic)" = 32,
      "Fire (periodic)" = 64,
      "Energy (periodic)" = 128,
      "Lifedrain" = 256,
      "Manadrain" = 512
    )

    active_types <- names(damage_types)[bitwAnd(bf, damage_types) > 0]
    paste(active_types, collapse = ", ")
  })
}

# Define attribute configuration
equipment_attr_config <- list(
  "BodyPosition" = list(output_name = "body_position", type = "integer", default = NA_integer_),
  "ArmorValue" = list(output_name = "armor_value", type = "integer", default = 0L),
  "DamageIncrease" = list(output_name = "damage_increase", type = "integer", default = 0L),
  "DamageReduction" = list(output_name = "damage_reduction", type = "integer", default = 0L),
  "ProtectionDamageTypes" = list(output_name = "protection_damage_types", type = "integer", default = 0L),
  "WeaknessDamageTypes" = list(output_name = "weakness_damage_types", type = "integer", default = 0L),
  "AvoidDamageTypes" = list(output_name = "avoid_damage_types", type = "integer", default = 0L),
  "SkillModification" = list(output_name = "skill_modification", type = "integer", default = 0L),
  "SkillNumber" = list(output_name = "skill_number", type = "integer", default = NA_integer_),
  "MinimumLevel" = list(output_name = "minimum_level", type = "integer", default = 0L),
  "Professions" = list(output_name = "professions", type = "integer", default = NA_integer_),
  "CriticalHitChance" = list(output_name = "critical_hit_chance", type = "integer", default = 0L),
  "CriticalHitIncrease" = list(output_name = "critical_hit_increase", type = "integer", default = 0L),
  "ShieldDefendValue" = list(output_name = "shield_defend_value", type = "integer", default = 0L),
  "Capacity" = list(output_name = "capacity", type = "integer", default = 0L),
  "Brightness" = list(output_name = "brightness", type = "integer", default = 0L),
  "LightColor" = list(output_name = "light_color", type = "integer", default = 0L),
  "Meaning" = list(output_name = "meaning", type = "character", default = "")
)

# Extract equipment attributes
extracted_attrs <- extract_attributes(items$parsed_attrs, equipment_attr_config)

for(col_name in names(extracted_attrs)) {
  items[[col_name]] <- extracted_attrs[[col_name]]
}

# Prepare lookup tables
loot_lookup <- item_loot_sources |>
  left_join(creatures, by = c("creature_id" = "id")) |>
  group_by(item_id) |>
  summarize(lootable_from = paste(unique(tools::toTitleCase(name)), collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop")

sell_lookup <- item_prices |>
  filter(mode == "sell") |>
  left_join(npc_locations, by = "npc_name") |>
  group_by(item_id) |>
  summarize(
    sell_npc = first(npc_name),
    sell_price = max(price),
    sell_npc_html = ifelse(
      !is.na(first(x)),
      generate_npc_map_link(first(npc_name), first(x), first(y), first(z)),
      first(npc_name)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

buy_lookup <- item_prices |>
  filter(mode == "buy") |>
  left_join(npc_locations, by = "npc_name") |>
  group_by(item_id) |>
  summarize(
    buy_npc = first(npc_name),
    buy_price = max(price),
    buy_npc_html = ifelse(
      !is.na(first(x)),
      generate_npc_map_link(first(npc_name), first(x), first(y), first(z)),
      first(npc_name)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Function to create equipment table
create_equipment_table <- function(body_position_filter) {
  items |>
    filter(body_position == body_position_filter) |>
    left_join(loot_lookup, by = c("type_id" = "item_id")) |>
    left_join(sell_lookup, by = c("type_id" = "item_id")) |>
    left_join(buy_lookup, by = c("type_id" = "item_id")) |>
    mutate(
      Image = ifelse(
        type_id %in% available_items,
        paste0('<img src="../../asset/img/item/', type_id, '.png" width="32" height="32">'),
        '<span style="display:inline-block;width:32px;height:32px;background:#e0e0e0;border-radius:3px;"></span>'
      ),
      Name = name,
      Armor = armor_value,
      `Dmg+` = damage_increase,
      `Dmg-` = damage_reduction,
      `Min Lvl` = ifelse(minimum_level > 0, as.character(minimum_level), ""),
      `Skill+` = ifelse(skill_modification != 0,
                       ifelse(skill_modification > 0, paste0("+", skill_modification), as.character(skill_modification)),
                       ""),
      `Crit%` = ifelse(critical_hit_chance > 0, as.character(critical_hit_chance), ""),
      `Crit Dmg` = ifelse(critical_hit_increase > 0, as.character(critical_hit_increase), ""),
      `Shield Def` = ifelse(shield_defend_value > 0, as.character(shield_defend_value), ""),
      Protection = decode_damage_types(protection_damage_types),
      Weakness = decode_damage_types(weakness_damage_types),
      Avoid = decode_damage_types(avoid_damage_types),
      Light = ifelse(brightness > 0, as.character(brightness), ""),
      Capacity = ifelse(capacity > 0, as.character(capacity), ""),
      Weight = weight / 100,
      Description = ifelse(is.na(description) | description == "", "", description),
      `Rewarded From` = ifelse(is.na(rewarded_from) | rewarded_from == "", "", rewarded_from),
      `Lootable From` = ifelse(is.na(lootable_from), "", lootable_from),
      `Sell To` = ifelse(!is.na(sell_npc), paste0(sell_npc_html, " (", sell_price, " gp)"), ""),
      `Buy From` = ifelse(!is.na(buy_npc), paste0(buy_npc_html, " (", buy_price, " gp)"), "")
    ) |>
    select(Image, Name, Armor, `Dmg+`, `Dmg-`, `Min Lvl`, `Skill+`,
           `Crit%`, `Crit Dmg`, `Shield Def`, Protection, Weakness, Avoid,
           Light, Capacity, Weight, Description, `Rewarded From`,
           `Lootable From`, `Sell To`, `Buy From`) |>
    arrange(desc(Armor), desc(`Dmg+`), desc(`Dmg-`))
}
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Helmets

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

equipment_data <- create_equipment_table(1)
DT::datatable(equipment_data,
          options = list(
            pageLength = 25,
            searching = TRUE,
            ordering = TRUE,
            columnDefs = list(
              list(width = '50px', targets = 0)  # Image column
            )
          ),
          rownames = FALSE,
          escape = FALSE,
          filter = 'top')
```
